title: Ten Commandments Crossword Puzzle — Bible Crossword
heading: The Ten Commandments Crossword
description: A Ten Commandments Bible crossword from Exodus 20: two tablets of stone, Mount Sinai, and the law of the LORD. Play free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: Two tablets of stone, carried down from Sinai — the Ten Commandments are the backbone of the law, and this puzzle sets them into a grid. Clues cover the commands themselves and the story around them: the graven image not to be worshipped, what it means to covet, the One who gave the commands.

It pairs naturally with the mini Written in Stone, and with Out of Egypt and The Ten Plagues for the wider Exodus story. Solve it and the grid closes on the commandment with a promise — honour thy father and thy mother.

clues.text: Graven image not to be worshipped
The One who gave the commands

verseText: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
